## SDPO: Self-Distillation Policy Optimization

<!-- image -->

Figure 4: Example of self-teaching with Qwen3-8B. The answer is generated by the model before seeing the feedback. Then, we re-evaluate the log-probs of the original attempt with the self-teacher after seeing the feedback. We show the per-token log(P(self-teacher)/ip (student) ), with red indicating negative values (sel!-teacher disagrees) and white indicating values around zero. Notably, in this example, Qwen3-8B identifies the error through retrospection without an explicit solution. Further, the activation is sparse, identifying where mistakes happen and adjusting to the students' response distribution.
